title: $L^p$ Decay Estimates for Circular Means of Fractal Measures in $\mathbb{R}^2$
summary: In this paper, we investigate weighted $L^p\rightarrow L^q$ restriction estimates for the Fourier extension operator associated with planar curves of non-vanishing curvature. More precisely, we establish estimates of the form \begin{equation} \|Ef\|_{L^q(X)}\leq C_εR^ε\|f\|_p, \end{equation} where $X$ is an $α$-dimensional set. As an application of this result, we derive a new $L^p$ decay estimate for circular means of Fourier transforms of fractal measures in $\mathbb{R}^2$. We also construct examples that give several upper bounds for the decay exponent when $p\in[1,2]$.
